title: ProjectOverhaul
description: Overhauls Minecraft in different ways like adding new bosses, weapons, QOL Features, Structures, etc.
body:
This project is aimed to improve the minecraft experience by adding new structures, bosses, QOL features, weapons, sounds, performance, etc. I will be updating this to have more features and also fix bug changes.


[https://modrinth.com/mod/another-furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/another-furniture)
